learning_outcomes.text: Explain that many AI systems learn patterns from data
Describe what training data is and why its quality matters
Explain the idea of features and labels in simple terms
Describe how bias in data can lead to unfair results
Explain in simple terms how a model makes a prediction
Discuss why testing an AI on new data matters

integrative_case: Learners act as a mini machine-learning team: they build a tiny labelled dataset of fruit by features, notice it has no examples of one fruit, predict a new item, discover a biased result, trace it to the missing data, and test on unseen fruit.
